beats.anchor: Maman rit si fort qu'elle renverse son café.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his sun-yellow T-shirt with the red stripe on the left of the chest, a smudge of chocolate on one eyebrow, small soft afro. BriBri in a plain green T-shirt, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist, shaved part on the left. Maman Estelle with her braids gathered in a bun, big golden earrings, a teal and yellow wax-print dress. Papa Armand with his short neat beard and a light blue shirt.
beats.action: At the breakfast table, Kaydoudou, half standing up from his chair, lifts his half-eaten pain au chocolat high like a trophy, eyes shining, grinning with the gap in his teeth. Maman laughs so hard that her coffee cup tips over and splashes the table. Papa, amused, catches the cup too late. BriBri, chin in his hand, points at the chocolate on his brother's eyebrow with a dry little smile.
beats.location: The small kitchen of a third-floor flat in Bussy-Saint-Georges, a window onto a little balcony and a train station below, a baguette on the table, a paper bakery bag with no writing on it.
beats.light: Fresh early September morning light through the window, warm and golden on the table.
beats.camera: Medium shot across the table, Kaydoudou's raised pastry at the top centre, Maman's spilling cup in the foreground on the left.
beats.alt: Au petit déjeuner, Kaydoudou lève son pain au chocolat comme une coupe et Maman rit si fort qu'elle renverse son café.

beats.anchor: Le ballon est chez un défenseur, loin.
beats.extras: Two 12-year-old trial players in yellow bibs: one with pale skin and short brown hair, one with dark skin and short black hair, standing a few metres apart with a clear gap of grass between them. Far back, a defender in an orange bib, light olive skin, about to pass the ball.
beats.outfit: BriBri in an orange bib over his old faded green shirt with the white collar and white number 8, black worn boots, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist. Kaydoudou in an orange bib over his yellow T-shirt, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot.
beats.action: BriBri, before the ball even comes, snaps his head over his shoulder like a little bird on a branch, eyes sharp and calm. In the gap between the two yellow bibs, far beyond, Kaydoudou stands alone on tiptoe, arms out, ready to run. The ball is still at the defender's feet in the distance.
beats.location: An artificial pitch beside the river Marne at the ESM training centre, a white building in the background, a barge sliding on the water.
beats.light: Late September afternoon, golden raking light, long shadows stretching across the green turf.
beats.camera: Dynamic over-the-shoulder shot from just behind BriBri's head, his turning face sharp in the foreground, the gap and Kaydoudou framed in the distance.
beats.alt: Avant même de recevoir, BriBri tourne la tête comme une mésange et voit Kaydoudou seul derrière le trou.

beats.anchor: Kaydoudou se fige, une jambe en l'air.
beats.extras: Monsieur Bertrand Lacombe, 55, pale skin, short grey hair, a thick grey moustache trimmed like a shoe brush, navy tracksuit, a metal whistle on a lace, seen far away from behind, walking off along the touchline without turning around, one finger raised.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in an orange bib over his yellow T-shirt, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot. Papa Armand in a light blue shirt, short neat beard.
beats.action: Next to a corner flag, Kaydoudou is frozen in the middle of Roger Milla's corner dance, one hand on his hip and one leg up in the air, eyes wide with comic shock, mouth in a round O. Behind the metal rail, Papa crouches down, hiding his laughter behind his hand, shoulders shaking. Far away, Lacombe walks off with his back turned.
beats.location: The corner of an artificial pitch by the river Marne at the ESM centre, a white metal rail around the pitch, other parents blurred behind it.
beats.light: Golden end-of-afternoon light, long shadows, the river shining in the distance.
beats.camera: Wide shot from the pitch, Kaydoudou and the corner flag in the foreground, Papa crouching behind the rail, tiny Lacombe walking away on the far right.
beats.alt: Près du poteau de corner, Kaydoudou se fige au milieu de la danse de Roger Milla pendant que Papa cache son fou rire.
